payload.title: Review the current repository and summarise the Stage 0 deferred issues recorded in the Autopilot event logs and reports. Do not modify any files.

outOfScope: all production code — this task is read-only and produced no edits

.ai/tasks/TASK-0002..TASK-0005 and DEPLOY-PRODUCTION event logs, which contain no DEFERRED or BACKFILL_GAP events; their textual matches are prose references to the schema enum inside DESIGN_DECISION and IMPLEMENTATION payloads, not records
re-adjudicating CDX-S0-01..04, which are CONFIRMED, fixed and runtime-verified
fixing the deferred credit-note edit defect, which is Stage 1 work owned by TASK-0001

summary.allRecordedUnder: TASK-0000 (Stage 0 — make accounting write failures fail closed), state READY_TO_MERGE, branch fix/stage0-ledger-failure-propagation @ 0c6c8735b

items.why: the onEdited handler is invoked but always short-circuits on !isOpen because the edit payload omits openedAt and the usage columns (upstream 76fc32078); fixing it changes edit semantics, which is Stage 1 work
evidence: CommandCreditNoteDTOTransform adds openedAt only when !oldCreditNote?.openedAt, and seeds refundedAmount/invoicesAmount only when !oldCreditNote, so on edit creditsRemaining is NaN and NaN > 0 is false
stage0-final-atomicity.stage0-spec.ts:189 — test 1b pins the short-circuit as current, intended-for-now behaviour
items.downstreamStatus: TASK-0001 (Fix Credit Note inventory edit, risk=high, branch ai/task-0001) opened against this item and ESCALATED at seq 2 without any design or implementation: no `codex` executable on the host or in the bc-node container, and reviewer-provider independence is a hard policy. The deferral is therefore still open and now blocked on tooling, not on analysis.

items.source: absence of any stored Codex transcript
items.why: Stage 0 predates the observatory; Codex reviews were relayed by the human as prose and the verbatim reviewer output was never captured, so it cannot be reconstructed without inventing it
items.consequence: the independent-review step of Stage 0 has no primary artefact; its quality is attested only by the human relay

items.what: reviewer miss rate / finding precision denominators
items.why: only findings that were raised are recoverable; issues nobody raised leave no trace, so precision and recall cannot be computed from Stage 0
items.consequence: the observatory counters (4 raised, 4 CONFIRMED, 0 PARTIAL, 0 REJECTED) have no denominator and cannot be read as reviewer accuracy at any sample size

summary.adjacentNotVerifiedNote: these three appear in the TASK-0000 report's NOT VERIFIED / OUT OF SCOPE section but were never emitted as DEFERRED or BACKFILL_GAP events. They are scope exclusions, not deferrals, and they carry no event-log provenance.
summary.reconstructionCaveat: all 35 TASK-0000 events are reconstructed (HIGH=26, MEDIUM=9). Every deferral record above is a rebuild authored by tools/autopilot/backfill-stage0.ts, not a contemporaneous emission. All three carry HIGH confidence, and DEFERRED-1's substance is independently corroborated by live source and a committed test.

invariants: The set of Stage 0 deferral records is exactly {DEFERRED seq 32, BACKFILL_GAP seq 3, BACKFILL_GAP seq 33}, all in .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl.
The .ai/reports/TASK-0000.md NOT VERIFIED section reproduces every DEFERRED and BACKFILL_GAP payload verbatim; report and log never diverge.
The report's 'explicitly deferred items: 1' and 'known evidence gaps: 2' counters equal the count of DEFERRED and BACKFILL_GAP events respectively in the same log.
A BACKFILL_GAP is an assertion that evidence is absent, not that a defect exists; it must never be converted into a FINDING.
The credit-note edit inventory rewrite stays deferred — its handler unreachable and its unreachability pinned by test 1b — until a Stage 1 task deliberately changes edit semantics.
No file in this repository was modified by TASK-0005.
Reviewer-provider independence stays a hard policy: the TASK-0001 escalation is the correct outcome, not a fault to route around.
falsifiablePredictions: Parsing every .ai/tasks/*/events.jsonl and filtering on type ∈ {DEFERRED, BACKFILL_GAP} returns exactly 3 records, all with taskId TASK-0000. A 4th record anywhere falsifies this summary.

Every DEFERRED/BACKFILL_GAP substring hit in TASK-0002, TASK-0003 and TASK-0004 lies inside a payload string field, never in a top-level "type" field. One that does not falsifies the claim that Stage 0 owns all deferrals.

Editing an existing credit note with inventory-tracked items produces zero rows in INVENTORY_TRANSACTIONS attributable to the rewrite path. Any such row falsifies DEFERRED-1's premise that the handler is unreachable.

Instrumenting CreditNoteInventoryTransactionsSubscriber.rewriteInventoryTransactionsOnceEdited on an edit shows entry and an immediate return at the !isOpen guard. Reaching editInventoryTransactions falsifies the deferral rationale.

On the edit path, creditNote.creditsRemaining evaluates to NaN. A finite value falsifies the stated NaN > 0 mechanism, which would mean the guard fails for a different reason and the recorded rationale is wrong even if the symptom holds.
Test 1b in stage0-final-atomicity.stage0-spec.ts passes on the current tree. If it fails, the deferral has already been silently resolved or regressed and the record is stale.
Recomputing each event's EV- content hash reproduces the stored eventId for all 3 records. A mismatch means the deferral log was edited after the fact and none of the above is trustworthy.
No Stage 0 artefact contains a Codex design-review transcript for TASK-0000. Producing one falsifies GAP-1 — and, given the actor is backfill, would more likely indicate fabrication than recovery.
implementationConstraints: None. TASK-0005 is a read-only review; no production code was written or modified, per the task statement and the architect role.
Any follow-up that acts on DEFERRED-1 must open a new Stage 1 task with its own risk rating; it must not ride on TASK-0005.

Resolving DEFERRED-1 requires changing CommandCreditNoteDTOTransform's edit payload (openedAt, refundedAmount, invoicesAmount) and will invalidate test 1b, which asserts the current short-circuit. That test must be rewritten in the same change, not deleted.
The two BACKFILL_GAP records must not be closed by reconstruction. Absence of evidence stays visible; backfill-stage0.ts's own contract records a gap rather than a plausible-looking invention.
Unblocking TASK-0001 means installing the Codex CLI or setting AI_CODEX_BIN, not relaxing the independence policy or substituting Claude as reviewer.
requiredTests: No new tests. This task adds no behaviour.

For any future task that closes DEFERRED-1: a test proving the onEdited handler reaches editInventoryTransactions on a real edit, and a test proving inventory rows are rewritten to match the edited lines.

For any future task that closes DEFERRED-1: an atomicity test in the Stage 0 style proving an inventory-rewrite failure during edit rolls the credit-note edit back, so closing the deferral does not reopen CDX-S0-01's class of defect.
Regression guard: the Stage 0 suite (29 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped) and the Stage -1 canonical baseline (55 clean, 0 regressions) must both stay green across any change to this area.
requiredRuntimeAcceptance: None for TASK-0005 — no runtime behaviour changed. Verification here was static: event-log parse, report cross-read, and source inspection of the live guard.

For any future task that closes DEFERRED-1: single-thread database evidence in the CDX-S0-04 style — BEGIN, credit-note UPDATE, INVENTORY_TRANSACTIONS rewrite, forced failure, ROLLBACK with no COMMIT — followed by a post-rollback state check showing the credit note unchanged and no orphaned inventory rows.
knownUnverified: EV- content hashes were not recomputed; event-log integrity is assumed, not proven.
The unreachability of the onEdited handler was confirmed by reading the guard, the isOpen getter and the committed test's reasoning — not by running the test or observing a live edit in this task.
Upstream commit 76fc32078, cited as the origin of the omitted edit-payload columns, was not inspected.

GAP-2 is self-referential and unclosable: this review can enumerate deferrals that were recorded, but by that gap's own logic it cannot detect Stage 0 issues that were never raised. The true deferral count is a lower bound.
GAP-1 means the Codex design review of Stage 0 remains unauditable; whether the 4 findings were the reviewer's complete output is unknowable.

Whether the three NOT VERIFIED items (tax/FX/rounding, historical production data, async COGS worker) were consciously deferred or merely never scoped cannot be determined — no event records the decision.
TASK-0001's escalation cause was read from its event log; no independent check was made that `codex` is still missing from the host and the bc-node container as of this review.

findings.claim: The design claims an exhaustive repository-wide count of exactly three DEFERRED/BACKFILL_GAP records while excluding TASK-0002 through TASK-0005 and DEPLOY-PRODUCTION logs from the scope allowlist.
findings.scenario: If an excluded log contains a fourth top-level DEFERRED record, an implementation obeying the allowlist cannot inspect it and will still publish the count of three, producing a false Stage 0 summary.
findings.violatedInvariant: Any exhaustive claim about all repository event logs must be derived from inspecting every log included in the claimed population; the stated exact-set invariant must be testable within the authorized scope.
findings.evidenceAvailable: The contradiction is explicit in the design: the scope allowlist includes only TASK-0000 and TASK-0001 logs, while the out-of-scope section and falsifiable predictions make assertions about TASK-0002 through TASK-0005 and DEPLOY-PRODUCTION. Repository inspection was unavailable because the read-only execution sandbox failed to initialize.

findings.claim: The design converts a historical escalation reason into the present-tense conclusion that TASK-0001 is still blocked on tooling, despite explicitly stating that current Codex availability was not checked.
findings.scenario: If Codex was installed after the recorded escalation, TASK-0001 may remain marked ESCALATED in its historical log while no longer being blocked by missing tooling; the summary would incorrectly report the current blocker.
findings.violatedInvariant: Historical event evidence must not be presented as verified current state without a contemporaneous check; recorded status, recorded cause, and present recoverability must remain distinct.
findings.evidenceAvailable: The downstreamStatus says the task is 'still open and now blocked on tooling,' while knownUnverified says no independent check was made that Codex is still missing as of this review.

payload.reasoning: The reviewer's factual premise is falsified, but its process objection is real and narrower than BLOCKER. Direct inspection of every event log in the repository — .ai/tasks/{TASK-0000..TASK-0005, DEPLOY-PRODUCTION}/events.jsonl, the complete population — returns exactly three records whose top-level "type" is DEFERRED or BACKFILL_GAP, all in TASK-0000: seq 3 EV-c6e945908dc32a4a (BACKFILL_GAP, Codex transcript), seq 32 EV-e174e65a8593d391 (DEFERRED, credit-note edit inventory rewrite), seq 33 EV-5fe39a3dfaf562b2 (BACKFILL_GAP, precision denominators). A regex over top-level type keys across all seven logs produced six hits total: those three, plus three inside TASK-0005 line 3, which is a single DESIGN_DECISION event whose payload embeds this very design document. Every substring hit in TASK-0002/0003/0004 lies on a line whose top-level type is DESIGN_DECISION or IMPLEMENTATION; DEPLOY-PRODUCTION and TASK-0001 contain zero occurrences of either token. TASK-0000 has 35 events, matching the design's reconstruction caveat. So falsifiable predictions 1 and 2 both hold as stated, the exact-set invariant is true, and the design's characterisation of the excluded logs is accurate — which it could only be because the designer did read them. What survives is a scope-hygiene defect: scopeAllowlist lists only the TASK-0000 and TASK-0001 logs, so the read set required to test invariant 1 and prediction 1 is not authorised by the design's own scope statement, and the outOfScope entry asserts a content claim about logs the allowlist forbids opening. That is a genuine internal inconsistency — an exhaustive claim must authorise reading its full population — but it is a documentation fault in a read-only task that wrote nothing, not a blocker, and the feared fourth record does not exist. The reviewer states its own sandbox failed to initialize, so the finding is inference from the document alone; runtime evidence outranks it.
payload.requiredFix: Amend the design document only — no code change. (1) Split scope into a read scope and a write scope: read scope becomes `.ai/tasks/*/events.jsonl` (all seven logs, DEPLOY-PRODUCTION included) plus `.ai/reports/TASK-0000.md` and `.ai/schema/events.schema.json`; write scope stays empty, since TASK-0005 modified no file. (2) Move the TASK-0002..TASK-0005 / DEPLOY-PRODUCTION sentence out of outOfScope into an inspected-and-excluded finding, restating it as a verified result rather than an assumption: all seven logs were parsed, only TASK-0000 carries top-level DEFERRED/BACKFILL_GAP records, and every other hit is a payload substring inside DESIGN_DECISION or IMPLEMENTATION events. (3) Restate invariant 1 to name its population explicitly: 'across all .ai/tasks/*/events.jsonl'. (4) Downgrade this finding's severity to a documentation defect; the summary's count of three stands unchanged.
payload.requiredEvidence: A committed scan artefact that (a) enumerates all seven .ai/tasks/*/events.jsonl paths it opened, (b) parses each line and reports the count of records with top-level type in {DEFERRED, BACKFILL_GAP} per file, and (c) shows totals of 3 for TASK-0000 and 0 for every other log, with the three eventIds EV-c6e945908dc32a4a, EV-e174e65a8593d391 and EV-5fe39a3dfaf562b2 listed. It must also list, per file, every line where the tokens appear only inside a payload, with that line's top-level type, so DESIGN_DECISION/IMPLEMENTATION prose hits are visibly distinguished from records. The amended design must show the read scope covering exactly the files that artefact opened; if the two sets differ, the fix has not landed. Note that this evidence closes only the enumeration question — it says nothing about GAP-2's self-referential limit, so the true deferral count remains a lower bound, as the design already records under knownUnverified.
